query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM entity_access ea
                JOIN harnesses h ON h.id = ea.entity_id AND h.deleted_at IS NULL
                WHERE ea.entity_id = $1
                  AND ea.entity_type = 'harness'
                  AND ea.source_type = 'team'
                  AND ea.source_id = $2
            ) AS "granted!"
